words.en: The data decision catalog cannot be read. Read the offered workspace view and retained backups; restore an intact workspace before retrying. Nothing was changed.
words.zh-CN: 无法读取数据决策目录。请读取提供的工作区视图并检查保留的备份，恢复完整的工作区后重试。本次读取未作任何更改。

words.en: The feature document is invalid. Read the offered controls or inputs, correct the invalid fields and plan again; keep your research choices.
words.zh-CN: 特征文档无效。读取提供的控制项或输入，修正无效字段后重新规划；保留你的研究选择。

words.en: The strategy declaration is invalid. Read the offered strategy controls, correct the invalid fields and plan again; keep your research choices.
words.zh-CN: 策略声明无效。读取提供的策略控制项，修正无效字段后重新规划；保留你的研究选择。

reason.en: Daily updates outlive the first-use delegation.
reason.zh-CN: 每日更新超出首次使用授权的有效期。

scope.en: Workspace network and default SEC consent until the person says stop.
scope.zh-CN: 本工作区网络及默认额度的 SEC 同意，直到本人要求停止。

way_on.en: Relay the person's words for the two offered requests.
way_on.zh-CN: 为所提供的两条请求逐字转达本人的答复。

words.en: May AlphaLattice keep this workspace's network on for your daily updates, to fetch new market data and SEC filings within the default budget (3 per issuer, 600 documents and 3 GB overall), until you tell me to stop? Each use is recorded in the activity log and shown in the Workbench.
words.zh-CN: AlphaLattice 可以为你的每日更新保持此工作区的网络开启，在默认额度内（每个发行人 3 份，总计 600 份文件和 3 GB）获取新的市场数据和 SEC 文件，直到你让我停止吗？每次使用都会记录在活动日志中，并在工作台中显示。

reason.en: Network access outside a valid delegation needs the person.
reason.zh-CN: 有效授权之外的网络访问需要本人决定。

scope.en: This workspace's network control; no source consent or offline-hold override.
scope.zh-CN: 本工作区的网络控制；不授予来源同意，也不解除离线限制。

way_on.en: Read network show and relay the person's words with network set.
way_on.zh-CN: 读取 network show，并通过 network set 逐字转达本人的答复。

words.en: Network access is the person's decision outside a first use: ask the person in one line and, on a clear yes, send this again with --person-said and --asked; `network show` reads what decides it.
words.zh-CN: 首次使用之外的网络访问由本人决定：用一句话询问本人，得到明确同意后，携带 --person-said 和 --asked 再次发送同一请求；`network show` 可查看决定网络状态的依据。

words.en: Summary only. Read the complete answer at {pointer}.
words.zh-CN: 这里只显示摘要。完整答复请读取 {pointer}。

words.en: Full stdout is deprecated; use the summary view and --output for the complete answer.
words.zh-CN: 标准输出中的完整答复已弃用；请使用摘要视图，并通过 --output 保存完整答复。

words.en: Read a bounded summary with pointers to the complete answer.
words.zh-CN: 读取有大小限制的摘要，其中提供完整答复的读取位置。

words.en: Time profile
words.zh-CN: 用时分析

words.en: Recorded coverage
words.zh-CN: 已记录的覆盖范围

words.en: Unattributed time
words.zh-CN: 未归因用时

words.en: Critical path incomplete
words.zh-CN: 关键路径记录不完整

words.en: Use --output to save the complete profile; stdout stays bounded in every view.
words.zh-CN: 用 --output 保存完整用时分析；所有显示模式的标准输出都有长度上限。

words.en: This launch could not prove escape from Windows Job containment, so it left no detached Host running. On Claude Code desktop, first run terminal_command yourself in an available agent-driven Terminal panel; Codex uses the same route when its panel is available. Only without such a panel, give the person that command for a terminal they own and wait for their word. Both routes keep the same escape and readiness checks; the app may ask approval for the line.
words.zh-CN: 本次启动无法证明已脱离 Windows Job 的约束，因此没有留下独立运行的 宿主。在 Claude Code 桌面应用中，优先自行通过可用的代理工具在 Terminal 面板运行 terminal_command；Codex 的面板可用时也走同一路径。只有没有这种面板时，才把同一命令交给本人在其持有的终端运行，并等待本人的话。两条路径都保留相同的脱离约束和就绪检查；应用可能要求批准这一行命令。

host.start.breakaway_denied.description: Explains the ordered agent-panel and person-terminal recovery routes without claiming the Host can inspect agent tools.

words.en: With --person-said: the registered code beside the question.
words.zh-CN: 与 --person-said 同用：问题旁的已注册代码。

words.en: The update resumed on the checkpoint its own data stage moved its universe to; the update's ledger names both checkpoints and the names the move added.
words.zh-CN: 本次更新在其自身数据阶段推进股票池后的检查点上继续运行；更新账本记录了前后两个检查点及新增的名称。

words.en: A cancelled update had left its candidate list active before its Panel published it; the active membership was returned to the Panel's own, and the step recorded once.
words.zh-CN: 一次已取消的更新在其 Panel 发布前留下了处于生效状态的候选名单；生效成员已恢复为 Panel 自身的成员，这一步只记录一次。

words.en: The active stock list is bound by the maintenance cycle this refusal names, which never finished, and no update's own plan proves which Task bound it, so it stays bound and nothing ran. Read the data update's record; the research and history already recorded stay readable. To keep updating, prepare a new workspace from the current source.
words.zh-CN: 当前生效的股票清单由本次拒绝所指明的维护周期绑定，该周期从未完成，且没有任何更新自身的计划能证明是哪个任务绑定了它，因此它保持绑定，没有执行任何操作。请读取数据更新的记录；已记录的研究和历史仍可读取。要继续更新，请从当前来源准备一个新的工作区。

words.en: Fill the remaining judgments and send this one request; its references are selected.
words.zh-CN: 填写余下的判断并发送这一条请求；引用已选好。

words.en: This Host is stopping and did not admit this request. Once it has stopped, serve this workspace again and retry the refused request.
words.zh-CN: 此主机正在停止，未接纳本次请求。主机停止后，请重新启动此工作区的主机，再重试被拒绝的请求。

words.en: A detached Host stays while a held update, Task, request or enabled automation needs it; otherwise it stops after {seconds} idle seconds (0 disables idle shutdown).
words.zh-CN: 分离运行的主机在待执行的更新、任务、请求或已启用的自动更新仍需要它时会继续运行；否则，空闲 {seconds} 秒后会自动停止（0 表示禁用空闲自动停止）。

words.en: The declared Terminal panel is the first offered route after this launch could not prove escape from Windows Job containment and left no detached Host running. On Claude Code desktop, run terminal_command yourself through the available panel tool; Codex follows the same route when available. Only without an agent-driven panel, give the person the same command for their terminal and wait for their word. The escape and readiness checks still apply; the app may ask approval for the line.
words.zh-CN: 本次启动无法证明已脱离 Windows Job 的约束，未留下独立运行的 宿主；已声明的 Terminal 面板是优先提供的路径。在 Claude Code 桌面应用中，自行通过可用的面板工具运行 terminal_command；Codex 可用时也走同一路径。只有没有可由代理操作的面板时，才将同一命令交给本人在其终端运行，并等待本人的话。脱离约束和就绪检查仍然适用；应用可能要求批准这一行命令。

host.start.breakaway_denied.panel.description: Explains the ordered agent-panel and person-terminal recovery routes without claiming the Host can inspect agent tools.

words.en: Host {instance} (process {pid}) has served this workspace since {started_at}.
words.zh-CN: 宿主 {instance}（进程 {pid}）自 {started_at} 起为此工作区提供服务。

words.en: The recorded Host could not be authenticated. Read host_log and identify this workspace's owning Host before retrying the original serve command; leave the descriptor and writer lease unchanged.
words.zh-CN: 无法验证所记录的 宿主。请先读取 host_log 并确认此工作区由哪个 宿主 持有，再重试原来的 serve 命令；不要改动连接描述或写入租约。

words.en: A matching serving Host can be reused even when this shell cannot detach a new process. ALREADY_SERVING reuses only an authenticated Host for this workspace and instance, preserving its authority and idle policy. Activity's observer names its instance, process and start time; the Workbench shows the same Host. On an unverified or stale descriptor, read the named Host log and identify its owning process before retrying the original serve command; leave the descriptor and writer lease unchanged.
words.zh-CN: 即使当前命令环境无法另起独立进程，仍可复用经过验证、匹配的已有宿主。ALREADY_SERVING 只复用经过验证、属于此工作区及实例的 宿主，并保留其权限和空闲策略。工作区活动的观察信息会列出其实例、进程和启动时间；工作台显示同一个 宿主。若连接描述过期或无法验证，请先读取所指出的 宿主 日志并确认持有它的进程，再重试原来的 serve 命令；不要改动连接描述或写入租约。

words.en: Goal time profile
words.zh-CN: 目标用时分析

words.en: The record is complete; read its outcome, limitations and report here.
words.zh-CN: 记录已完整；请在这里查看结果、限制和报告。

words.en: The Goal is sealed; the report is unavailable. Use its offered repair request.
words.zh-CN: 目标已封存；报告暂不可用。请使用提供的修复请求。

words.en: This launch could not own its attached child and left no Host running. Run terminal_command in another terminal.
words.zh-CN: 本次启动无法持有附属子进程，因此未留下运行中的宿主。请在另一个终端执行 terminal_command。

words.en: The operation could not be completed ({reason}).
words.zh-CN: 操作未能完成（{reason}）。

words.en: The request field {field} is invalid.
words.zh-CN: 请求字段 {field} 无效。

words.en: The installed command may be off PATH. Use its absolute launcher from `uv tool dir --bin` in this session; no shell update or restart is needed.
words.zh-CN: 已安装的命令可能不在搜索路径中。在本次会话使用 `uv tool dir --bin` 下启动程序的绝对路径，无需更新终端设置或重启。

words.en: Run the documented locked install and disclose it. Use the absolute launcher from `uv tool dir --bin` when it is off PATH; specialists use the same command in fresh shells. Check any unproved command owner first.
words.zh-CN: 按文档进行锁定安装并说明所做操作。若命令不在搜索路径中，使用 `uv tool dir --bin` 下启动程序的绝对路径；专家在新终端中使用同一个命令。若命令归属尚未证实，先核实。

words.en: Off PATH, use the binding block in the shared guides and pass the matching absolute prefix to every specialist; no shell update or restart is needed. Portable examples use alphalattice as a placeholder. When serving from another shell, set ALPHALATTICE_SHELL to your specialists' shell: posix or powershell.
words.zh-CN: 命令不在搜索路径中时，请用共享指南中的前缀绑定说明，并把对应的绝对命令前缀交给每位专家；无需更新终端设置或重启。可移植示例中的 alphalattice 是占位写法。从另一种终端启动服务时，将 ALPHALATTICE_SHELL 设为专家所用终端的格式：posix 或 powershell。

setup.tool.guide.description: Explains the canonical command binding used by first-use setup and configured guidance.

words.en: Use the lead's resolved command_prefix wherever this card shows alphalattice; its permitted operations stay the same.
words.zh-CN: 本卡中出现 alphalattice 时，使用负责人提供的已解析 command_prefix；允许执行的操作不变。

setup.tool.specialists.description: Explains the canonical command binding used by first-use setup and configured guidance.

words.en: Use these prefixes in place of `alphalattice`: PowerShell `{powershell}`; Bash `{posix}`.
words.zh-CN: 用以下命令前缀替换示例中的 `alphalattice`：PowerShell `{powershell}`；Bash `{posix}`。

setup.tool.prefixes.description: Explains the canonical command binding used by first-use setup and configured guidance.

words.en: On Claude Code desktop, use the available Terminal panel through `run_in_terminal`; on Codex, use an available agent-driven Terminal panel in the same way. If detached start is refused, choose the first applicable `terminal_routes` offer and run `terminal_command` yourself there. Only without such a panel, give the person the same command for a terminal they own, then wait for their word. The Host cannot inspect your tools; its escape and authenticated readiness checks still decide STARTED.
words.zh-CN: 在 Claude Code 桌面应用中，通过 `run_in_terminal` 使用可用的 Terminal 面板；在 Codex 中，同样使用可由代理操作的面板。独立启动遭拒时，选择 `terminal_routes` 中首条适用路径，并自行在那里运行 `terminal_command`。只有没有这种面板时，才把同一命令交给本人在其持有的终端运行，然后等待本人的话。宿主 无法查看你的工具；能否返回 STARTED 仍由脱离约束和身份验证后的就绪检查决定。
